basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old architect based in Portland, Oregon, with a passion for both real-world and digital building. My interests revolve around architecture, gaming, and the latest blockchain trends. I often spend my evenings and weekends exploring new ideas and gaming with friends online. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom it provides to dive deep into my hobbies. My typical online hours are in the late evenings, usually from 8 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in architecture and several years of professional experience, I've honed my skills in design and structural aesthetics. My interest in technology led me to explore blockchain and cryptocurrency, which I keep up with through self-study and active participation in online communities.
